API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIProvisioning Key ManagementGets details of all configured Provisioning Keys for the specified customer.
Gets details of all configured Provisioning Keys for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/associationType/:associationType/provisioningKey

Gets details of all configured Provisioning Keys for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

associationType
string
REQUIRED

Specifies the Provisioning Key type for App Connectors or ZPA Private Service Edges. The supported values are CONNECTOR_GRP, NP_ASSISTANT_GRP and SERVICE_EDGE_GRP.

QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

OK

*/*
Schema
Example (auto)

int64
list

totalCount
